profile.headline: Software engineer who transforms ideas into software products
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer who is always looking for improving and developing new skills. Enjoys reading books, building personal & job software projects and sharing my knowledge with everyone.  I like all the software processes from requirements elicitation, developing, testing to deploying and scaling my applications into the cloud. 

4+ years of experience in software development, using technologies like:
Python, Scrapy, Selenium, Docker, Django, REST, Twisted, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Google & AWS.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Mentoring · Interviewing · Technical Documentation · Django · Python · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Working as contractor in Avast Software s.r.o. in Emeryville California. Writing UI automated tests in Swift, using tools like Jenkins, AppCode & Xcode

positions.title: QA Engineer
positions.description:
Support testing process and troubleshooting issues and resolving them.
Implementing continuous integration (CI) in the development process.
Providing unit test, stress test and regression test for the platform. 
Test automation with Selenium, Saucelabs and Jenkins.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed distributed, reliable and scalable webcrawlers with python, twisted, scrapy and selenium in EC2 instances. Downloaded millions of images and data in S3 Buckets and CouchDB.
Developed web applications  (front end/backend) in java EE, jquery & bootstrap building analytics modules to analice data and trends. 
Researched, tested, evaluated and proposed new implementations and open source tools.

positions.title: Summer Development Internship
positions.description:
As an intern I developed macros in Microsoft Excel  using vba (Visual Basic for Applications) creating a system who analices and measures the quality of the products. 
Developed an entire system for the inventory control using Visual Basic .Net

positions.title: Intern Software Developer
positions.description: As an intern I created new modules in the main project who is a medical software made in Visual Basic and SQL Server.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
As a web developer I contributed to the creation of web applications in Php, jquery and Mysql doing front end and back end. 

☑ Created a web based tool to handle and improve logistics of the client's company. The application was built in Javascript, Php and Mysql.

☑ Created a real time web application to show data provided from bluetooth antennas. The application was built in Php, Java, Javascript and Mysql.

publications.title: A web-based tool for conducting process improvement initiatives with local industry collaboration
publications.publisher: Computer Applications in Engineering Education · Sep 30, 2013
